name: NetApp ONTAP
description: Shows a NetApp ONTAP cluster (AFF, FAS, ASA, ONTAP Select, Cloud Volumes ONTAP) with its nodes, aggregates and their fill level, volumes and LUNs, disks, the hosts that mount a volume over NFS, and the open health events. Read-only, through the ONTAP REST API (ONTAP 9.8 or newer).
author: Netlens
supports: ONTAP 9.8 and newer (written from the published REST API reference; simulator only, not tested on a real cluster)

releases.changelog: First release. Needs Netlens 0.4.178 or newer (kind storage).
